name: Dedicated Institutional Ground Station
explain: Single owned and operated university or institutional tracking dish. Lowest annual operating cost, but provides contact only when the satellite passes directly overhead.
basis: Standard University SmallSat Ground Station, approximate, game-balanced

name: Global Commercial Ground Station Network
explain: Federated multi-station network (e.g. KSAT / SSC / AWS Ground Station) with 8 polar and mid-latitude sites providing high-frequency contact passes for Earth observation.
basis: Kongsberg Satellite Services (KSATlite) / AWS Ground Station, approximate, game-balanced

name: NASA Near Space & Deep Space Network (DSN/NSN)
explain: Tri-continental deep-space tracking network (Goldstone, Madrid, Canberra) equipped with 34-meter and 70-meter parabolic dishes for cislunar, Lagrange, and interplanetary telemetry.
basis: NASA Deep Space Network Telecommunications Link Design Handbook, approximate, game-balanced
